ComplianceControlAsset.description:
One asset's Pass/Fail tally for a single control (the compliance page's
control drill-down panel, Assets tab). ACCEPTED folds into `pass_count`, same as
everywhere else in this module; MUTED findings are excluded from both counts
(they show up under the panel's "All" filter, not under Pass or Fail).
ComplianceControlAsset.title: ComplianceControlAsset

ComplianceFamilySettings.description:
Per-framework-family configuration (US-14.19): whether it's shown on the
Compliance page and counted in tenant-wide aggregates (ThreatScore, top failing
checks), plus the desired By Control score. The target is display-only today (a
vs-goal indicator wherever the score already appears) but is modeled as its own
field so a future alerting job (Ogum.Pulse) can read it without a schema change —
see `compliance_service` doc for how `enabled` filters aggregates.
ComplianceFamilySettings.title: ComplianceFamilySettings

ComplianceFamilySettingsView.description:
One row of `GET /api/v1/settings/compliance` — settings merged with the
family's identity so the frontend doesn't need a second lookup to label the row.
ComplianceFamilySettingsView.title: ComplianceFamilySettingsView

ComplianceFrameworkDetail.description:
Response for `GET /api/v1/compliance/frameworks/{id}` (US-14.14/15/16/19).

See `ComplianceSectionNode` for the By Control fold rule, mirrored here at the
framework-total level. `target_by_control` is the desired score from Compliance
Settings (US-14.19), `None` when no goal is configured for this framework's
family — display-only today (a vs-goal indicator wherever the score appears),
not enforced anywhere.
ComplianceFrameworkDetail.title: ComplianceFrameworkDetail

ComplianceRequirementNode.description: A single control, resolved against the AWS catalog when available (US-14.16).
ComplianceRequirementNode.title: ComplianceRequirementNode

ComplianceScoreTrendPoint.description: One daily By Control snapshot for the Score Trend chart (US-14.15/US-14.18).
ComplianceScoreTrendPoint.title: ComplianceScoreTrendPoint

ComplianceSectionNode.description:
One level of the section -> sub-section -> requirement tree (US-14.15/16),
By Control: ACCEPTED folded into Pass, MUTED folded into Unscored, any FAIL on
the control wins regardless of how many assets pass. Score = (Pass + Unscored) /
Total — a control nobody has evaluated yet counts toward the compliant side, not
against it (see `compliance_service._score_by_control`).

`subsections` is only populated when the catalog's Attributes carry an explicit
sub-section (NIST 800-53 does; most other frameworks don't) — a section with no
sub-section data attaches its `requirements` directly, so the accordion degrades
from 3 levels to 2 rather than rendering an empty middle tier.
ComplianceSectionNode.title: ComplianceSectionNode

DiscoverRequest.description:
Optional body for POST /{id}/discover.

Allows re-providing ephemeral credentials for providers registered with
credential_type='static' / 'service_principal' / 'service_account' / 'kubeconfig'.
Credentials passed here are forwarded to the task and never stored.
Omit the body (or all fields) to use ambient worker credentials / stored role_arn.
DiscoverRequest.title: DiscoverRequest

(see `compliance_service.py`), reusing its family/section resolution helpers.

implemented, so there is no LLM path to fall back *from*. This response shape

SoftwareInventoryResponse.description:
Software Inventory sub-tabs (US-14.06).

Installed Packages and Licenses are derived from the CycloneDX SBOM already
generated by Side-Scanning (Epic 03). Applications and Running Services have no
data source anywhere in the platform yet — `*_available=False` signals the
frontend to render an explicit "not available yet" state instead of fabricated
data, matching the precedent set for other un-wired tabs in Epic 14 Sprint 2.
SoftwareInventoryResponse.title: SoftwareInventoryResponse
